name: pionless-agent
description: Coding-workflow agents and skills for Codex: hoah-coder (focused coding session with built-in reviewer loop), parallel-fix (batch issue fixer with isolated worktree workers), socratic-tutor, and freshwater-doctor.

interface.shortDescription: Coding-workflow agents: focused coder, parallel fixer, socratic tutor
interface.longDescription: Coding-workflow agents and skills. hoah-coder runs a focused triage → implementation → review loop for one task at a time. parallel-fix dispatches batches of small fixes to isolated git-worktree workers. Also ships socratic-tutor and freshwater-doctor skills.
defaultPrompt: Use the hoah-coder agent for a focused coding task with a built-in reviewer loop.
Use the parallel-fix skill to scan for a class of issues and dispatch fixes in parallel.
